notes.title: Big Changes Are Coming to Urbex Murder! A Devlog Update
notes.notes:
A New Standard for Movement
The biggest change is a brand-new movement system. We've switched to Motion Matching, a technology that makes character animations more fluid and realistic than ever before. This means your character will now transition seamlessly between actions such as running, stopping, and turning will feel incredibly natural and responsive, making the entire experience feel more grounded.


Redesigned Parkour and Interaction
We've completely redesigned how you'll traverse the world. Our new parkour system is now more dynamic and intuitive, giving you newfound agility to navigate abandoned spaces. You'll move with fluid realism as you climb, vault, mantle, and hurdle over obstacles with ease.

Beyond movement, we've also added pushable objects, opening up new possibilities for puzzles and navigation. We’ve also polished the entire interaction system, so actions like opening doors and picking up items will feel more consistent and responsive.


New Tools for Teamwork
Urbex Murder need is a team effort, and these new tools are designed to help you work together more effectively:

Glow Sticks: These are perfect for lighting up dark corners and marking areas for your team, adding both a strategic and atmospheric element to your exploration.

Ping System: Communicate silently and effectively with your team using the new ping system. Mark important items, doors, or even lurking threats without needing to use voice chat.
[previewyoutube="mRsUWfo7dVU;full"][/previewyoutube]

Introducing a Brand New Subway Level
We're excited to introduce a massive overhaul of the Subway Level. While it may start in a familiar place, the changes are so extensive that it has been completely reimagined. We've added so many new routes, sections, and secrets that it's basically a new place to explore.

We’re in the final stages of testing and polishing this massive update. We can't wait for you to get your hands on it and experience the game in a whole new way. Thank you for your continued support and patience. We'll be announcing the official release date very soon, so keep your flashlights ready!

notes.title: Urbex Murder 1.9.4 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Community feedback changes:

Based on your feedback, we've made the following improvements:

 Fixed an issue where subway doors sometimes wouldn't animate properly for clients.
 Fixed a bug causing trains to not animate correctly on the client side.
 Players can no longer block each other.


Thank you for your support! Your feedback helps us improve the game. Keep it coming!

notes.title: Urbex Murder 1.9.3 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Community feedback changes:

We've received multiple reports about issues with the train, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Based on your feedback, we've made the following improvements:

[olist]
 Added a movable train to enhance gameplay.
 Fixed a black screen issue in multiplayer mode caused by the train.
 Corrected several French translation errors for a better experience.
[/olist]

Thank you for your support! Your feedback helps us improve the game. Keep it coming!
